name: Lotte Tour Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Lotte Tour Development Co., Ltd., through its various subsidiary companies, is a prominent provider of travel and tourism solutions across South Korea. The enterprise's extensive range of services covers the conceptualization and execution of tourism projects, facilitating both domestic and international travel bookings, and functioning as a comprehensive ticket sales agency. Beyond these core offerings, Lotte Tour Development also manages casino operations, offers foreign currency exchange, provides expert advisory services, and maintains an internet press division. Furthermore, the company delivers specialized courses, including those focused on pre-establishment guidance. Founded in 1971, its primary operational base is located in Seoul, South Korea.
